endpoint.description: The webhook endpoint's removal outcome; retained means a routine or another attention target still names it. No secret is returned.

name.description: A webhook endpoint's name on its environment: 1 to 40 lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, unique.

state.description: Removed with this route, retained for another user, or already missing.

secretKind.description: The credential removed with the endpoint: a saved signing secret, an external key-manager reference, or no credential. Absent when the endpoint was retained or already missing.
